_note: PLACEHOLDER used only until model/export/signs.json exists. Descriptions are unverified; motions are synthetic, not recordings.

signs.label: milk
signs.description: Squeeze an open hand into a fist twice, like milking.

signs.label: more
signs.description: Tap the fingertips of both hands together, twice.

signs.label: drink
signs.description: Hold a C hand like a cup and tip it toward your mouth.

signs.label: food
signs.description: Tap your bunched fingertips to your mouth.

signs.label: water
signs.description: Tap a W hand on your chin twice.

signs.label: hungry
signs.description: Move a C hand down the middle of your chest.

signs.label: all done
signs.description: Hold both open hands up and twist them outward.

signs.label: sleep
signs.description: Draw an open hand down in front of your face, closing it.

signs.label: bed
signs.description: Rest your cheek on your flat hand, like a pillow.

signs.label: night
signs.description: Bend one hand over the back of the other, like the sun going down.

signs.label: moon
signs.description: Trace a crescent near your eye with your thumb and index finger.

signs.label: wake up
signs.description: Open your pinched fingers beside your eyes, like eyes opening.

signs.label: bath
signs.description: Rub both fists up and down on your chest, like scrubbing.

signs.label: clean
signs.description: Wipe one flat palm across the other.

signs.label: wet
signs.description: Bring both hands down while gently closing the fingers on the thumbs.

signs.label: dry
signs.description: Draw a bent index finger across your chin.

signs.label: toothbrush
signs.description: Brush side to side in front of your teeth with your index finger.

signs.label: mom
signs.description: Tap your chin with the thumb of an open hand.

signs.label: dad
signs.description: Tap your forehead with the thumb of an open hand.

signs.label: grandma
signs.description: Start like mom at the chin, then bounce the hand forward twice.

signs.label: grandpa
signs.description: Start like dad at the forehead, then bounce the hand forward twice.

signs.label: please
signs.description: Rub a flat hand in a circle on your chest.

signs.label: thank you
signs.description: Touch your fingertips to your chin and move the hand forward.
